item.title: [Bug] Custom model GLM-5.1 (Z AI Coding Plan) fails with error 4054 due to unrecognized SSE `progress_notice` event
item.body:
## Bug Description

When using GLM-5.1 from Z AI Coding Plan as a custom model in Trae, the AI Agent frequently fails with **error code 4054** ("Custom model internal error occurred"). The root cause is that GLM-5.1 sends `progress_notice` SSE events during long-running tasks, which Trae's SSE parser does not recognize, causing the stream to be incorrectly terminated.

## Environment

- **Trae Version**: 1.0.18 (2026-03-26)
- **OS**: macOS 26.4.1 (Apple Silicon)
- **Model**: GLM-5.1 via Z AI Coding Plan
- **API Endpoint**: `https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4`
- **Mode**: Both Agent and Plan mode affected

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Configure Z AI Coding Plan GLM-5.1 as a custom model in Trae
2. Send a request that requires significant processing time (e.g., searching logs or analyzing large codebases)
3. GLM-5.1 starts processing and periodically sends `progress_notice` SSE events (every ~2 seconds)
4. Trae's SSE parser logs: `WARN: Unknown event: Event { event: "progress_notice", ... }`
5. The SSE stream is terminated prematurely
6. Error 4054 is returned to the user

## Actual Behavior

From `ai-agent` stdout log:
WARN ai_agent::infrastructure::adapter::llm::event: Unknown event: Event { event: "progress_notice", data: ""Processing_1776098203"", id: "1293801935", retry: None }
WARN ai_agent::infrastructure::adapter::llm::event: Unknown event: Event { event: "progress_notice", data: ""Processing_1776098205"", id: "1293801936", retry: None }
... (repeated every 2 seconds)
ERROR ai_agent::infrastructure::aha_net::stream: [AhaNetHTTPClient/Stream][Error] is_queue_continue false, error: ErrorEvent { message: "Custom model internal error occurred. Please check the proxy response for details.", code: 4054 }


The SSE stream reports "ended normally after 3 messages in 9.9s" — only 3 actual content messages were received before the stream was terminated due to unrecognized events.

## Expected Behavior

Trae should recognize and **ignore** `progress_notice` SSE events (and `context_usage` events), continuing to wait for actual `content` events from the model. These are heartbeat/progress indicators from GLM-5.1 and should not cause stream termination.

## Error Frequency

In a single 37-minute session, this error occurred **8 times**, making GLM-5.1 nearly unusable:

| Time | Error Code | Duration |
|------|-----------|----------|
| 00:08:32 | 4054 | 48.5s |
| 00:13:29 | 4054 | 178.4s |
| 00:14:29 | 4054 | 51.2s |
| 00:27:37 | 4054 | - |
| 00:31:33 | 4054 | - |
| 00:31:43 | 4028 | HTTP 500 |
| 00:36:08 | 4054 | - |
| 00:36:33 | 4054 | - |

## Technical Details

- The SSE parsing logic resides in the Rust-compiled `libai_agent.dylib` (source: `apps/icube_server_rs/crates/custom-model-proxy-client/src/default_handler.rs` and `stream_manager.rs`)
- GLM-5.1 sends two unrecognized SSE event types: `progress_notice` and `context_usage`
- Z AI's official documentation confirms `progress_notice` is a standard event for their Coding Plan API
- This issue also affects GLM-5-Turbo and GLM-4.7 when they send progress events during long-running tasks
- MCP tool names are duplicated in the logs (Notion, Exa Search registered twice), contributing to larger request bodies (~78KB)

## Suggested Fix

In the SSE event parser (`custom_model_proxy_client`), add `progress_notice` and `context_usage` to the list of recognized but ignorable SSE event types. The parser should log these at DEBUG level and continue waiting for content events without terminating the stream.
